caption:
Google's Universal Cart is rolling out today in the US in Search and the Gemini app.
Save items from different stores in one cart, get alerts on price drops and restocks, and check out faster.
Save this for your holiday shopping.

Would you let Gemini watch prices for you?

Follow @neurafeed.ai for daily AI news.

Source: Google Blog · Photo: Google

slides.headline: Google's AI now hunts price drops for you. Here's how to use *Universal Cart*

slides.heading: Step 1: *Save* as you shop
paras: Shop in AI Mode in Google Search or chat with the Gemini app, then save the products you like to your Universal Cart.
It works across retailers, so items from different stores sit in one cart, and your progress is still there when you come back.

slides.heading: Step 2: Let it *watch prices*
paras: While items sit in your cart, Google keeps checking them for you.
You get a notification when a saved product drops in price or when an out of stock item is available again.

slides.heading: Step 3: Use your *card perks*
paras: The cart is built on Google Wallet. It understands your card perks and helps you pick which card to pay with.
It also surfaces relevant promo codes before you buy.

slides.heading: Step 4: *Check out* fast
paras: At participating stores like Nike, Sephora, Target, Ulta Beauty, Walmart and Wayfair, you can pay with Google Pay in a few taps.

paras.t: Or send the items to the store's own cart and finish there. The store stays the seller for confirmations and support.

slides.hook: Universal Cart is live in the US right before the holidays. Follow for more AI shopping tricks.
